recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core FHIR follow-up is needed unless OO wants a broader editorial harmonization to make NutritionIntake.reported[x] match the Event pattern wording exactly; current source is semantically correct and in build scope.
issue_request: FHIR-44994 was an Applied/Persuasive OO change request for R6. It reported that the NutritionIntake.reported[x] description read as though the element only described who reported consumption information, leaving the Boolean choice unclear; the approved resolution was to adapt the Event pattern description for NutritionIntake.
initial_application: Commit 1dc1c4ae89127b3ac2794da0d1d5bf9a8bbf9d5c applied FHIR-44994 by replacing the old person-or-organization wording with reported-vs-primary/source wording for NutritionIntake.reported[x]. The same commit also bundled adjacent NutritionIntake changes for other issues, but the reported[x] hunk is the seed issue application.
additional_context: NutritionIntake is active in source/fhir.ini and assigned to OO. The Event pattern defines reported[x] as indicating a secondary reported record rather than an original primary source-of-truth record and optionally the source of the report. OO Nutrition minutes on 2024-03-27 record an 8-0-0 vote to adapt the Event pattern description for NutritionIntake.reported[x]. A later QA commit adjusted the NutritionIntake wording but preserved the reported-vs-primary Boolean meaning.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current authoritative source in source/nutritionintake/structuredefinition-NutritionIntake.xml already says NutritionIntake.reported[x] indicates a reported rather than primary record and may also indicate the source that provided the consumption information, which is sufficient to explain the Boolean value.
